results.title: Family Matters
results.overview: Elder sister, Spring, seeks her origins before heading to university, Autumn, the mother, grapples with conceiving a child through artificial insemination, Summer, the younger brother, tries to engage with a paternal figure he barely knows just before his military service, and Winter, the father, desperately tries to change his fate as problems mount up.

results.title: Big Mama Thornton: I Can’t Be Anyone But Me
results.original_title: Big Mama Thornton: I Can’t Be Anyone But Me
results.overview: Inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2024, Alabama-born Willie Mae “Big Mama” Thornton defied the gender norms of her time to become one of the greatest blues singers of her generation. Known for her powerful voice and uncompromising style, she rose to fame with the original recording of “Hound Dog” and later wrote “Ball & Chain,” a song that gained iconic status through Janis Joplin’s rendition.

results.title: Thanks For The Room
results.overview: Laid off due to the viral illness sweeping the globe, Byron is barely holding his life together. With eviction looming and his marriage crumbling, he takes a job as a midnight courier at a pandemic hotel for the unhoused, hoping to scrape together enough cash to keep his family afloat.

results.title: Worth the Wait
results.overview: A group of strangers' lives fatefully intertwine as they navigate budding love, confront profound loss, and encounter old flames.

results.title: A Reconciliation at the Donut Shop
results.original_title: A Reconciliation at the Donut Shop
results.overview: A homeschooled girl from Pennsylvania tries to reconnect with her estranged half-sister and land a marketing job at their uncle’s donut shop by hiring an actor to reenact a reunion that never happened. A satire of branded content and short films.

results.title: Furlow
results.overview: Sumittar Singh, a tailor-turned-food inspector, enjoys the newfound power, respect, and bribes his position brings. As he starts raiding businesses and clashes with a local don, he inadvertently becomes a hero to the villagers. Will Sumittar`s rise to power end in his success or downfall?

results.title: MyGO!!!!!×TOGENASHI TOGEARI Versus Live "Avoid Note"
results.original_title: MyGO!!!!!×トゲナシトゲアリ「Avoid Note」

results.title: Don't Dream About Me
results.overview: After dreaming about the death of his small-town barber, filmmaker Jesse Ridgeway embarks on a harrowing journey to uncover the true nature behind precognition.

results.title: The Family Road
results.overview: Ready to go on vacation, Kamel finds himself forced to change his plans at the last minute and hit the road to Bled with his mother. Aboard the old Renault 21, Kamel and his family embark on a long journey to Morocco. On the road to his past, memories and resentments resurface, revealing the beauty of the bonds that unite them.

results.title: Crónicas Paranormales - El especial de Navidad
results.original_title: Crónicas Paranormales - El especial de Navidad
results.overview: “Documentary” that shows Christmas 2009, where the Grajales family, a family of hunters, will have to come together to save (as much as possible) their Christmas.

results.title: A Falsetto Boy
results.overview: Winter 1996, Harbin. Sha Guo, a boy with a uniquely feminine singing voice, loves to sing but faces bullying and isolation at school, along with strict control and pressure from his obsessive mother. By chance, he meets Sitiao, a nightclub host and stage director. To defend his dignity, pursue his dreams, and find his true self, Sha Guo leaves home and, with Sitiao's support, steps onto the nightclub stage as a cross-dressing singer.

results.title: Girls Remix in Halloween Party
results.original_title: ガールズリミックス　ｉｎハロウィンパーティー
results.overview: Shizuka Nomura receives an invitation to a Halloween party, but no matter how many times she throws it away, it keeps coming back to her. Suspicious, Shizuka consults Akiko Narumi. Akiko infiltrates the Halloween party with the new members of the Girl Remix, Rinne Kudo and Nayuta Mikazuki! The host of the party is a surprise?! What kind of party will the Girls Remix experience?!

results.title: Dear Satan
results.overview: A girl accidentally misspells a letter and addresses it to Satan instead of Santa. The naughty Satan goes out of his way and bonds with the kid by introducing himself as Santa, in an attempt to corrupt her young mind and lead her to the bad side. But it would prove to be a hard task as the girl has only love and kindness in her heart.

results.title: Paternité : une métamorphose décryptée
results.overview: Becoming a father is an extraordinary adventure in a man's life, but it is also a real physiological metamorphosis that science is only just beginning to reveal. Researchers from multiple disciplines are lifting the veil on these changes taking place in men who are in contact with young children, and their discoveries are astonishing. By tracing the thread of evolution, the film reveals that these deep, long-ignored bonds between men and children are very ancient. And that they are just waiting for the right context to fully express themselves.

results.title: Facing War
results.overview: Jens Stoltenberg had planned to step down after nine years in the powerful position of NATO Secretary General. The 65-year-old politician had packed his bags to go home to his wife in Norway, as he had promised her. But then Joe Biden called and asked him to stay another year. Because in a troubled world, an experienced leader is needed more than ever. With unprecedented access, we follow Jens Stoltenberg through his last year as Secretary General of NATO.

results.title: Bucky!
results.overview: Produced by PBS Wisconsin, Bucky! chronicles the history and impact of the state’s most iconic mascot.

results.title: Mythomania
results.overview: When Ben embarks on a journey of self-discovery, guided by his therapist and fueled by a blossoming romance with Melody, he begins to revisit his memories — only to uncover unsettling inconsistencies, leaving us wondering: what is the truth?

results.title: The Fun-Raiser
results.overview: A married couple who run a performing arts high school throw a last ditch fundraiser to save the school and their students, despite a leaking roof, a flammable cake, a no-show celebrity, food poisoning, and their inner demons.

results.title: Forbidden Nights
results.overview: In 1987, a grieving teenager suspects her family is haunted by a sinister entity after her sister's death, leading her to uncover horrifying secrets from their past.
